body:
Many singular words cannot be re-singularized. Given that pluarlize(analysis) = analyses, and singularize(analyses) = analysis, I don't see an issue there.

Sieves does seem to be an issue though, as the plural form does not singularize properly.

I don't know (obviously) Cake's intended behavior for singularizing an already singular word. I can say I'm using it to ensure a word that I don't know is singular or plural is singular for when I need it. For most words I've come across, minus these cases, it's worked as I expect.

In other words, if that is the expected behavior of Cake's Inflector: re-singularizing an already singular word may not work, and I assume the same with plural words. Should the docs be updated to reflect that?

I'll also note: `analysis` is broken not just for the singularize when it tries to classify `analysis`, it breaks as well: `Inflector::classify("analysis") -> "analysi"`

http://inflector.cakephp.org/analysis

Edit: corrected cases and added link to Inflector site.

Again here the docs don't explicitly state you can't use a singular word when using classify (though all the examples in singularize and classify are plural formats), but it general it at least seems to "just work".

I don't think we've ever published any promises that Inflector::singularize() will do the right thing with singulars, but I know that both it and pluralize() are not safe to use on nouns in those formats. Perhaps that should be something that is made more clear in the documentation.

Fair enough, I'll work on a Docs PR to hopefully clarify this case.

Thank you.

issue.title: Adds clarifying language around pluralize and singularize
issue.body:
Adds a note to clarify that pluralize and singularize while in general will work with most English nouns, it is possible for them to have issues around singularizing a singular noun and same with pluralizing a plural noun.

Related CakePHP Core Issue that brought forth this change: https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/issues/6236#issuecomment-88313571
